# Senior Data Scientist, Demand Forecasting

**Kaveri Retail Pvt Ltd** · Bengaluru, India (hybrid) · 2 positions

Kaveri Retail runs 600 supermarkets across South India. Our forecasting team decides what
every store orders each day, and we are hiring two senior data scientists.

## What you will do

- Lead demand forecasting for 40,000 products across 600 stores.
- Measure the effect of promotions and price changes with experiments.
- Mentor junior data scientists.

## What we are looking for

- At least 6 years of experience in data science.
- Strong Python.
- Deep experience with demand forecasting at scale.
- Good SQL.
- Solid statistics.
- Experience running A/B tests or other experiments.
- You must be allowed to work in India.

## Nice to have

- LightGBM or other gradient boosting libraries.
- AWS.
- Retail analytics experience.

We offer a competitive salary, health insurance for your family and relocation support within India.
